name: finance-tracker
description: Track income and expenses with charts. Express and MongoDB API, React client.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start:memory: concurrently -n server,client "npm run dev:memory --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
